drhp.expansion: A new factory dedicated to the production of Veto LED products has been constructed and commenced operations in January 2025, centralizing production for improved efficiency, reduced operational costs, and increased capacity. demand_drivers.title: Mdna (RHP)
demand_drivers.body:
- Global electrical and electronics market expected to grow to $4986.91 billion in 2027 at a CAGR of 7.5%.
- Renewable generation sector seen as a promoting/advancing alternative for green power generation, though uncertain power output is a challenge needing storage systems and management tools.
- LED lighting in residential settings expected to continue growing in popularity due to lower energy use and longer life expectancy versus incandescent lighting.
- Government of India measures such as the 'Go Green' programme and 'Make in India 2.0' seeking to protect domestic manufacturers and push them up the value chain.
- Global wires and cables market projected to grow from $200.23 billion (2022) to $294.73 billion (2029) at a 5.7% CAGR, driven by transmission/distribution investment and demand from data centres and telecom.
- Construction cables and wire demand expected to see steep growth from government infrastructure spending, smart cities, and real estate.
- Global switchgear market projected to reach $170.40 billion by 2027 at a 6.6% CAGR, driven by rural electrification and rising investment.
- Global lighting market projected to reach $163.72 billion by 2027 at a 4.3% CAGR, driven by demand for energy-efficient and IoT-integrated products.
- Rising competitive intensity in the industry, offset by the strength of the company's product portfolio, distribution network, and brands.
- Rapid pace of innovation stimulating consistent demand for newer/faster equipment; technological development seen as key to attracting consumers upgrading from older products.

capex_expansion.title: Expansion (RHP)
capex_expansion.body: A new factory dedicated to the production of Veto LED products has been constructed and commenced operations in January 2025, centralizing production for improved efficiency, reduced operational costs, and increased capacity. The company incorporated two new subsidiaries during the year — Veto Polytech Private Limited (incorporated 24 September 2024, 55% held) and VNB Appliances Private Limited (incorporated 10 March 2025) — both described as material changes approved by the board. The company also installed a DG set of 250 KVA capacity as backup power to avoid disruption, alongside its sanctioned 400 KVA power supply from Uttarakhand Power Corporation Limited (of which approximately 325 KVA is presently utilised), which management says can meet its proposed modernization plans.

- brand: Long-standing regional brand equity — evidence: Promoters have been in the manufacturing and marketing of Veto brand products for over 55 years, with the Veto brand established in the electrical industry since 1967

risks.title: Risks (RHP)
risks.body:
- Company flags that new players entering the market are increasing competitive intensity as the industry grows, a threat to market share and pricing.
- High inflation rate is flagged as a risk that can slow the economy and challenge the business; rising input costs are separately cited as a headwind the company had to navigate.
- Company notes that demand for its products keeps changing in the fast-evolving market, affecting its production cycle.
- Disruption in supply chain listed among the company's identified risks.
- Company flags uncertainties in the financial market, credit risk, and interest rate risk, along with market risk on financial instruments including loans, borrowings, trade payables and deposits.
- Security and storage of data and records is listed as a flagged risk area.
- Common workplace risks (accidents, fires) and natural disasters (earthquakes, tornadoes) are listed as risks the company monitors.

strategy.title: Strategies (RHP)
strategy.body:
- Product innovation — investments in technology-driven processes and new product development.
- Distribution strengthening — expanding the dealer/distributor network and enhancing brand positioning.
- Sustainability focus — driving energy-efficient solutions.
- Digital transformation — leveraging digital tools to improve efficiency, transparency, and customer engagement.
- Enhance competitiveness through continuous research and development and product engineering to improve manufacturing processes.
- Improve existing assets to yield better output, and install new assets to enhance and attract new markets.
- Re-engineer existing products for greater customer adaptability and improve product molding and bonding processes (including silver layer re-working and bimetallic silver bonding) to attain cost efficiency.
